chapter.title: OF OFFENCES RELATINGTO THE ARMY, [4][NAVY AND AIR FORCE]

heading: Abetment of assault by soldier, sailor or airman on his superior officer, when in execution of his office.
text: Whoever abets an assault by an officer, soldier, [8][sailor or airman], in the Army, [9][Navy or Air Force] of the [10][Government of India], on any superior officer being in the execution of his office, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, and shall also be liable to fine.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
